# React Bits catalog

Generated by `scripts/sync_skills.py` from https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits at `e12c221` (218 components, flavor `TS-CSS` = TypeScript + plain CSS).
How to choose and add one: `skills/project/react-bits/SKILL.md`.
